reason: Section 54 assigns the burden of proof in gas distribution rate and tariff applications to the gas distributor.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Burden of proof in gas rate and tariff applications

evidenceText: burden of proof is on the gas distributor

proposedGroups.reason: The section contains one procedural burden rule for applications regarding rates and tariffs.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall who bears the burden of proof in an application regarding gas distribution rates and tariffs.

reason: Section 55 imposes filing, public-inspection, and public-copy duties for approved rate and tariff schedules.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Filed and publicly available gas rate schedules

evidenceText: shall file with the Board schedules
maintain at convenient locations in the Province
make available to a member of the public

proposedGroups.reason: Both subsections address how approved gas distribution service rates and tariffs must be filed and made available for inspection or request.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall where approved gas distribution rate and tariff schedules must be filed, kept, inspected, and made available.

reason: Section 56 is a single rule requiring Board approval and new filed schedules before any gas distribution rate or tariff change takes effect.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Board-approved changes to gas rates and tariffs

evidenceText: shall not make any change to its rates or tariffs
except with the approval of the Board
filed with the Board before the change comes into effect

proposedGroups.reason: The section links rate or tariff changes to Board approval, a Board-determined proceeding, and pre-effective filing of new schedules.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall the approval, proceeding, and schedule-filing requirements before changing gas distribution rates or tariffs.

reason: Section 57 combines service and facility safety duties with a pre-distribution inspection obligation.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Safe gas service and pre-distribution inspection

evidenceText: shall furnish safe, adequate and proper gas distribution service and facilities
Before distributing gas to any building
inspect the installations

proposedGroups.reason: The subsections together require safe service and facilities and an inspection before gas is distributed to a building.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall the safe-service duty and pre-distribution inspection requirement for gas distributors.

reason: Section 58 separates the certificate requirement for gas marketing activities, exemptions from that certificate requirement, and restrictions on using names other than the certified name.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Certificate required for gas marketing activities

evidenceText: unless the person holds a certificate
sell gas or offer to sell gas
arrange for pipeline capacity

proposedGroups.reason: Subsection 58(1) lists the marketing, agency, brokerage, and pipeline-capacity activities that require a certificate.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Identify the gas marketing activities that require a certificate.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Exemptions from gas marketer certificate requirement

evidenceText: are exempt from the requirement to hold a certificate
general franchise holder
gas fuelling station

proposedGroups.reason: Subsection 58(1.1) identifies the persons exempt from holding a certificate.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall which sellers, agents, brokers, the general franchise holder, and gas fuelling station operators are exempt from the gas marketer certificate requirement.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Certified gas marketer name restrictions

evidenceText: No gas marketer shall
in a name other than the one in which it is certified

proposedGroups.reason: Subsection 58(2) restricts certified gas marketers from carrying on listed activities under another name unless authorized in the certificate.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recognize when a gas marketer may use a name other than the certified name.

reason: Section 59 authorizes Board price regulation when gas or customer service prices are not subject to effective competition sufficient to protect customers.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Board price regulation when competition is insufficient

evidenceText: may make an order regulating the price
not subject to effective competition sufficient to protect the interests of customers

proposedGroups.reason: The section states both the competition finding and the resulting Board order power.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall when the Board may regulate gas or customer service prices charged by a gas marketer or gas distributor.

reason: Section 60 separates one current enforceability rule in subsection 60(1) from a repealed subsection 60(2), so the study focus should cover only the current subsection.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Unenforceable gas sale contracts with non-compliant sellers

evidenceText: contract for the sale of gas between a low volume consumer
not in compliance with section 58
may not be enforced

proposedGroups.reason: The current focus is subsection 60(1), which makes certain low-volume consumer gas sale contracts unenforceable against the consumer.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall when a gas sale contract cannot be enforced against a low volume consumer because the seller is not in compliance with section 58.

reason: Section 61 authorizes the Board to issue certificates and attach public-interest terms and conditions.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Board certificate issuance and conditions

evidenceText: Board may issue certificates
subject to such terms and conditions

proposedGroups.reason: The subsections define the Board's certificate issuance authority and the condition power attached to certificates.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall the Board's power to issue certificates and make them subject to public-interest terms and conditions.

reason: Section 62 lists the grounds that can disentitle an applicant from issuance or renewal of a certificate.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Grounds that disentitle certificate issuance or renewal

evidenceText: entitled to have a certificate issued or renewed unless
financially responsible
past conduct
contravention of this Act

proposedGroups.reason: The section is a single eligibility rule structured around specified exceptions to entitlement.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall the financial responsibility, conduct, compliance, and Board-condition grounds that can justify denying or not renewing a certificate.

reason: Section 63 applies section 62 disentitlement grounds to refusal, non-renewal, suspension, or revocation of certificates.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Refusal, suspension, revocation, and non-renewal of certificates

evidenceText: may refuse to issue a certificate
may refuse to renew a certificate, or may suspend or revoke one

proposedGroups.reason: The two subsections use the same entitlement and breach concepts to authorize certificate refusal, non-renewal, suspension, and revocation.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall when the Board may refuse, not renew, suspend, or revoke a certificate.

reason: Section 64 is a detailed procedural section covering notice and show-cause rights, consequences when no proceeding is requested, Board powers after a proceeding, parties and conditions, and voluntary cancellation.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Notice and show-cause request for certificate action

evidenceText: shall serve notice of the proposal
entitled to show cause
within fifteen days after service

proposedGroups.reason: Subsections 64(1) and 64(2) identify the notice, reasons, and written request needed to trigger a proceeding.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall the notice contents and fifteen-day show-cause request process when the Board proposes certificate action.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Board decision powers after certificate notice

evidenceText: may carry out the proposal
may hold the proceeding
attach such conditions
are parties to the proceeding

proposedGroups.reason: Subsections 64(3) to 64(6) describe what the Board may do depending on whether a proceeding is requested and who participates.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall the Board's powers and party rules after a proposed certificate refusal, non-renewal, suspension, or revocation.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Certificate cancellation at holder request

evidenceText: may cancel a certificate when the holder requests it

proposedGroups.reason: Subsection 64(7) is a distinct voluntary cancellation rule, subject to customer and public-interest protections.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recognize when the Board may cancel a certificate at the holder's written request.

reason: Section 65 permits a further certificate application based on new evidence or materially changed circumstances.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Renewed certificate application after new evidence or changed circumstances

evidenceText: further application for a certificate may be made
new or other evidence
material circumstances have changed

proposedGroups.reason: The section contains one renewed-application rule.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall when a further application for a certificate may be made after a previous application.

reason: Section 65.1 is a direct prohibition against delivering gas to customers without holding a licence.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Licence required to deliver gas to customers

evidenceText: No person shall deliver gas to customers unless the person holds a licence

proposedGroups.reason: The section states one licensing precondition for delivery of gas to customers.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recognize that delivering gas to customers requires a licence.

reason: Section 65.11 prohibits licensees from delivering gas to distribution-area eligible facilities during the specified period unless the customer holds an approval.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Approval required for licensee delivery in distribution area

evidenceText: August 31, 2039
no licensee shall deliver gas
unless the customer holds an approval

proposedGroups.reason: The section identifies the time period, delivery target, and customer approval condition.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall when a licensee may deliver gas to a customer at an eligible facility in the distribution area.

reason: Section 65.12 clarifies that gas fuelling station owners or operators providing vehicle gas fuelling services are exempt from obtaining a licence.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Gas fuelling station licence exemption

evidenceText: owner or operator of a gas fuelling station
is exempt from the requirement to obtain a licence

proposedGroups.reason: The section states one exemption from the licence requirement.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall the licence exemption for owners or operators of vehicle gas fuelling stations.

reason: Section 65.2 sets the licence application form and information requirements and permits the Board to assess a processing fee.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Licence application information and processing fee

evidenceText: application for a licence shall be made to the Board
contain the information required by the Board
may assess a processing fee

proposedGroups.reason: Both subsections describe how a licence application is made and the fee the Board may require.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall the form, information, and processing-fee requirements for licence applications.

reason: Section 65.21 authorizes the Board to issue a licence after an application made under section 65.2.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Board issuance of licence after application

evidenceText: On application in accordance with section 65.2
Board may issue a licence

proposedGroups.reason: The section contains one issuance authority tied to a proper licence application.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall when the Board may issue a licence.

reason: Section 65.22 authorizes the Board to impose appropriate terms and conditions on a licence.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Terms and conditions on licences

evidenceText: may impose any terms and conditions
on a licence

proposedGroups.reason: The section is a single licence-condition authority.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall that the Board may impose terms and conditions it considers appropriate on a licence.
